target_declaration: Field-measured in-situ laboratory soil properties (SOC concentration, pH in H2O, clay/sand/silt texture mass fractions). These represent static historical physical soil measurements, NOT dynamic multi-temporal degradation rate labels.

profiles_punjab_bbox.description: Standardized soil profile sites in Northwest India / Punjab agricultural basin

profiles_india_national.description: National benchmark soil profile sites across India

orgc_measured.description: Measured soil organic carbon observations across depth horizons (g/kg)

phaq_measured.description: Measured soil pH (in H2O) observations across depth horizons

clay_measured.description: Measured clay mass fraction observations across depth horizons (%)

sand_measured.description: Measured sand mass fraction observations across depth horizons (%)

silt_measured.description: Measured silt mass fraction observations across depth horizons (%)

processed_soil_table.description: Standardized topsoil plow layer (0-30cm) measured physical and chemical soil properties
